correctness.rationale: Complete exact enumeration of all 2^20 subsets by two logically different recognizers proves the face predicate. The 63143-face complex has explicit 31570 incidence matching pairs, one critical vertex and one critical six-simplex; all 410520 augmented Hasse edges undergo topological sorting with 63143 visited vertices. The ordinary matching is therefore acyclic, and the Forman CW model with one zero-cell and one six-cell is S6. Both GCC and Clang and an undefined-behavior sanitizer replay pass. Finite exhaustive verification is a proof for the particular finite complex; no infinite extrapolation is asserted.

value.rationale: The dodecahedral GP(10,2) graph is a canonical cubic symmetric girth-five graph outside the forest, cycle and chordal graph families of the motivating theory. Its two-independence complex has 510 maximal simplices in four dimensions as high as eleven, but is integrally homotopy equivalent to one six-sphere. The exact determination supplies a challenging natural graph benchmark and exposes nonpurity invisible to homotopy; it is not a renamed textbook family or an arbitrary parameter slice.
